fact_text: Meezan Bank's market capitalisation crossed PKR 1 trillion after the share closed near PKR 557.70 on Friday 10 July, according to the presenter.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Meezan Bank is described as the third Pakistani company to reach a PKR 1 trillion market value and the first Islamic bank to do so.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Meezan's market capitalisation was about PKR 630 billion in July 2025, so the roughly 60% rise to PKR 1 trillion took about a year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Meezan's share of national deposits rose from about 4.8% in 2015 to about 8.6% in 2025, which the presenter cites as why it is among the fastest-growing Pakistani banks.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The State Bank's climate-finance estimate puts Pakistan's requirement at about USD 331 billion through 2030, roughly USD 47 billion a year or about 10% of GDP.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Climate finance is expected to come mostly from developed economies, and the presenter stresses that Pakistan's climate need is far larger than its current IMF programme.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Climate disasters have cost Pakistan about USD 58.8 billion through 2025, including about USD 29.3 billion over 1992-2021 and about USD 28 billion from the 2022 floods.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan has more glaciers than any country outside the polar regions, and the presenter links glacier melt to the severity of its floods.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Workers' remittances reached about USD 41.6 billion in 2026, roughly 9% above the about USD 38.3 billion received in 2025.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The State Bank projects remittances of about USD 44 billion in 2027.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's trade deficit widened about 21.6% to roughly USD 39.5 billion in FY2026, with imports near USD 69.6 billion against exports near USD 30.1 billion.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Remittances are the main offset to the trade gap, and without them the State Bank would be losing much more foreign-exchange reserves, according to the presenter.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The State Bank's telegraphic transfer charges incentive paid local banks to waive fees on inward remittances above USD 200, so neither sender nor receiver paid and the State Bank absorbed the cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When that incentive is withdrawn, banks rather than the State Bank bear the waived-fee cost, which the presenter expects to weigh modestly on bank profits.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Sony Dharti remittance programme gave overseas Pakistanis reward points for sending money through formal channels, redeemable against immigration fees, duties on imported phones and some FBR payments.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The Sony Dharti programme stopped awarding new points from 1 July, while points already earned remain redeemable until 30 June 2027.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Savings-account depositors receive a minimum deposit rate set slightly below the policy rate, and banks may now negotiate a different rate on balances above PKR 10 million (about PKR 1 crore).
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Banks with the largest savings-account deposit bases, such as NBP, HBL, MEBL and UBL, can gain most from negotiated savings rates, partly offsetting the lost remittance-incentive cost.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Invest Park is a government digitisation platform that lets retail investors and companies buy government securities directly, reducing the state's reliance on bank intermediation.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Traditionally the government borrows from banks and banks buy government securities, so direct retail buying would shift part of that demand from banks to households and companies.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan is moving from state-set petrol prices toward market-determined pricing, with the state keeping a role in managing supply-chain reliability rather than setting pump prices.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Market-based fuel pricing would widen margins for refineries and listed oil marketing companies, but it also invites more competition, and the presenter sees both effects arriving together.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Refinery modernisation work depends on a refinery policy that must pass economic-coordination approval before upgrades begin, so the timing of capex follows the approval date.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A proposed dynamic petroleum levy would be cut when international oil prices rise and raised when they fall, backed by a price stabilisation fund, with the IMF engaged on the design.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Pakistan's CPI inflation was about 11.1% in June 2026, down from about 11.7% in May 2026.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Average CPI inflation for FY2026 was about 7.05%, after inflation had fallen to about 0.3% in April 2025 before rising again.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Higher international oil prices pass through to domestic fuel prices and push inflation back up, which can delay the interest-rate cuts that were expected.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The US imposed a 29% tariff on Pakistan in April 2025, which a Pakistani delegation negotiated down, according to the presenter, to about 19%.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The United States is Pakistan's largest single export market, so US tariff levels feed directly into the earnings of export-oriented companies.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A US forced-labour investigation covering about 60 countries, Pakistan included, carries a risk of an extra tariff of about 10%, which Pakistan is negotiating alongside its base rate.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: A blocked Strait of Hormuz can cut LNG supply, leading SNGPL to declare force majeure on RLNG deliveries and leaving RLNG-fired power plants in Punjab without fuel.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When RLNG plants cannot run, the grid must use other fuels, which either raises electricity bills or increases load-shedding; the presenter expects both pressures in Punjab and northern areas.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Under the PM Apna Ghar scheme, non-bank housing and investment finance companies can lend up to PKR 10 million and microfinance companies up to PKR 5 million, widening access for people without bank accounts.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The KSE-100 index returned about 89% in 2024 and about 60% in 2025, according to the presenter.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The KSE-100 returned about 44% in FY2026 despite the Iran-US war, and the presenter's compounded figure for 2024 to FY2026 is about 63% a year.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The KSE-100 fell about 25% from its January 2026 peak to its March 2026 low after war broke out, then recovered most of the loss by July.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Headlines on US-Iran strikes or ceasefire talks move Pakistan's equity index sharply in the short run, more than local fundamentals do, in the presenter's view.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: About 20,411 new stock-market accounts opened in June 2026, of which about 55% were facilitation accounts and about 84% were opened by men.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: About 25,000 new stock-market accounts opened in FY2026, about 85% of them from Gen Z and millennials, which the presenter reads as growing investor understanding of equity returns.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: When two telecom operators merge, as with the Telenor-Ufone deal, overlapping roles are usually cut, and the combined company may adopt a new brand name.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Many restaurants take cash and avoid digital payments, so the presenter argues tax authorities should target cash-only outlets through record checks rather than raise rates on taxpayers already in the net.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Governments often raise rates on taxpayers already registered rather than widening the base to those outside the net, a pattern the presenter cites in the Punjab restaurant sales-tax change.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Pakistan Needs $331 Billion! Meezan Bank Hits 1 Trillion! Taxes Increase Again | Shafy's Weekly' (YouTube transcript, undated)
